reason: I grab my Monster at the petrol station on the way to a shift, I'm not going to order a 12-pack online and wait at a Zásilkovna for a drink I've never tasted. It's 650 plus delivery up front for something that costs more per can than what I already drink.
objection: 54 CZK a can for 330 ml when a big Monster is 46, and I don't know if 80 mg with no sugar actually wakes me up the same way or just tastes like fizzy tea.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to buy a single cold can at Albert or a petrol station for around Red Bull money, or trying a free one first and it actually kicking in.
